﻿## Logs — root cause confirmed

Pulled the desktop updater logs from `%APPDATA%\ai.opencode.desktop\logs\` and `%LOCALAPPDATA%\@opencode-aidesktop-updater\`. The behaviour is reproducible and the root cause is unambiguous: **the updater is configured with `allowDowngrade: true`, and at some point the release feed advertised 1.17.1 as `latest` even though 1.17.2 was already published.** electron-updater then happily "updated" me from 1.17.2 → 1.17.1.

### Updater state file

`%APPDATA%\ai.opencode.desktop\opencode.updater`:

```json
{
  "ready": {
    "version": "1.17.1"
  }
}
```

### Pending download

`%LOCALAPPDATA%\@opencode-aidesktop-updater\pending\update-info.json`:

```json
{
  "fileName": "opencode-desktop-win-x64.exe",
  "sha512": "0wM8jbTc8qEapPeiySnosrptGEdx1eJBZSNkSnWJI1/PGkXOWBdHKQaBwOtR/rkFE181+uBrMk3VRlCNYHLr3A==",
  "isAdminRightsRequired": false
}
```

A full `opencode-desktop-win-x64.exe` (~115 MB) for **v1.17.1** is already staged in `...\pending\`, ready for "Install and Restart".

### Smoking-gun log (main.log, filtered)

From `logs\20260610T172356\main.log` — the timestamps tell the whole story:

```
[2026-06-11 01:23:56.866] [info]   app starting { version: '1.17.2', packaged: true, onboardingTest: false }
[2026-06-11 01:23:56.929] [info]   auto updater configured { currentVersion: '1.17.2' ... }
[2026-06-11 01:23:56.944] [info]   updater state changed { from: 'idle', to: 'checking' }
[2026-06-11 01:23:56.945] [info]   Checking for update
[2026-06-11 01:23:59.049] [info]   Update for version 1.17.2 is not available (latest version: 1.17.2, downgrade is allowed).
[2026-06-11 01:23:59.054] [info]   updater state changed { from: 'checking', to: 'up-to-date' }

   ... 10 minutes later, on the scheduled re-check ...

[2026-06-11 01:33:56.933] [info]   updater state changed { from: 'up-to-date', to: 'checking' }
[2026-06-11 01:33:56.933] [info]   Checking for update
[2026-06-11 01:33:58.493] [info]   Found version 1.17.1 (url: opencode-desktop-win-arm64.exe, opencode-desktop-win-x64.exe)
[2026-06-11 01:33:58.493] [info]   updater state changed { from: 'checking', to: 'downloading' }
[2026-06-11 01:33:58.494] [info]   Downloading update from opencode-desktop-win-arm64.exe, opencode-desktop-win-x64.exe
[2026-06-11 01:33:58.497] [info]   Cached update sha512 checksum doesn't match the latest available update.
                                   Cached:   0+YT9gYYYRSs+CoEWCK1Wu9rx5pTY+9BP3i37ba5eb6mvRV/vSlR4XB32Q5xE/i+0CZzp3iJOvhmW8GwoO0thA==
                                   expected: 0wM8jbTc8qEapPeiySnosrptGEdx1eJBZSNkSnWJI1/PGkXOWBdHKQaBwOtR/rkFE181+uBrMk3VRlCNYHLr3A==
[2026-06-11 01:33:58.506] [warn]   disableWebInstaller is set to false, you should set it to true if you do not plan on
                                   using a web installer. This will default to true in a future version.
[2026-06-11 01:33:58.507] [info]   Download block maps (old: ".../v1.17.2/opencode-desktop-win-x64.exe.blockmap",
                                                        new:  ".../v1.17.1/opencode-desktop-win-x64.exe.blockmap")
[2026-06-11 01:34:00.088] [info]   Differential download: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/releases/download/v1.17.1/opencode-desktop-win-x64.exe
   ... ~6 min of differential download ...
[2026-06-11 01:40:33.460] [info]   New version 1.17.1 has been downloaded to
                                   C:\Users\33993\AppData\Local\@opencode-aidesktop-updater\pending\opencode-desktop-win-x64.exe
[2026-06-11 01:40:33.467] [info]   updater state changed { from: 'downloading', to: 'ready' }
```

### What this shows

1. The first check at `01:23:59` returned **1.17.2 as latest** — and even then electron-updater logged `downgrade is allowed`, confirming the updater is built with `autoUpdater.allowDowngrade = true`.
2. **Ten minutes later**, the same endpoint returned **1.17.1 as latest**. Combined with `allowDowngrade: true`, electron-updater treated `1.17.1 < 1.17.2` as a valid update target instead of
